analyst_view.overall: Bottom side Venezia (20th, 6 points from 12, LLLWL) host in-form Bologna (9th, 18 points, unbeaten in five) at the Penzo on Friday evening; the numbers make Bologna clear favourites. Davide Nicola's Venezia lost 4-0 at Juventus last weekend and have scored only 3 in six; Sverko, Franjic and Adorante are still out, and reports differ on Mazzocchi, Correia and Basic: Fantapazz (24 Nov) expects all three to miss out, while 1000 Cuori Rossoblu (25 Nov) says they are back, probably on the bench. The numbers already take Mazzocchi and Basic off Venezia's goals (about -10% of Venezia's share), which looks about right whichever report holds, since none of them is likely to start. Raffaele Palladino's Bologna drew 1-1 with Udinese and miss Holm, Miranda and Enem, with El Azzouzi and Happonen also training apart on 25 November; these players have been out during the winning run, so Bologna's form already reflects it. Nicola is expected to keep nine or ten of the side that started in Turin, no referee is named yet, and nothing points away from the numbers, so I stay with them.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.4 goals, 1.6 of them for Bologna. Venezia have scored 3 in six and Bologna 12 in six, which the numbers already count, along with Mazzocchi and Basic missing; one report says those two are back but on the bench, so the numbers' small cut still fits. Bologna's absentees (Holm, Miranda, Enem) were also missing during their run, so I stay at about 2.4.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.9 corners, 4.8 for Bologna, already raised for Bologna's 39 corners in six and Venezia's 40 conceded. Bologna lose left-sided width without Miranda but Zortea, Orsolini and Cambiaghi still drive their wide play, and Venezia play wing-backs Hainaut and Haps in a 3-5-2, so nothing new points either way; I stay at about 8.9.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.6 cards, already lowered because Venezia have been booked only 5 times in six games. A relegation-threatened home side against a team chasing Europe could get edgy, but no referee is named yet and this is no derby, so I stay at about 3.6.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.2 shots, 14.2 for Bologna, already lifted for Bologna's 91 shots in six. Venezia under Nicola still get shots off (75 in six) even when losing, and both teams are expected to field near-settled sides, so I stay at about 25.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.3 shots on target, 4.8 for Bologna, already raised for Bologna's 33 on target in six and lowered for Venezia's low accuracy. Adorante is still out, so Venezia rely on Adams and Lauberbach up front, much as in recent games; I stay at about 8.3.
